text:
ivy: heads-up — release pipeline blocked on JS SDK publish for sample-app onboarding. semver-check marked a minor but the regen diff looks like enum casing changed only.
ci-bot: pipeline #6120 failed at publish step: https://ci.example.com/6120 (exit 1)
paul: can you paste the diff?
ivy:```diff
- export enum UserStatus { Active = 'Active', Suspended = 'Suspended' }
+ export enum UserStatus { ACTIVE = 'ACTIVE', SUSPENDED = 'SUSPENDED' }
```semver treats renamed enum values as breaking/minor. but this came from typegen normalizing to upper-case constants.
sam: why did typegen change casing? I think tools/typegen v3.4.1 introduced `enumStyle: "shouty"` default accidentally. local regen with `./tools/typegen --enumStyle=preserve` returns the old values.
paul: immediate mitigation: pin typegen to v3.4.0 in release CI, and add a check that flags enum-only casing diffs as "regen-only" if mapping metadata shows unchanged logical values.
ivy: also hitting onboarding e2e flakes: auth retry middleware appends a new "x-idempotency" header on retries which our tests assert for equality across attempts; this makes the publish job time out sometimes.
ci-bot: rerun queued job #6121 started by paul (reproduce).
sam: proposals: (A) CI: regen-diff gate that labels PRs with only `generated/` changes as `regen-only`, (B) typegen: flip default `enumStyle` back to `preserve` and add unit test to lock behavior, (C) tests: deep-clone headers/body on retry and ignore x-idempotency in equality checks.
paul: I'll own CI gate (A) and add a small script: `git diff --name-only -- generated/ && echo regen-only` so release-bot won't auto-minor.
ivy: sam take (B)? add a changelog note explaining the behavioral change if we ever want to change enumStyle.
sam: on it — will open PR to pin default and add regression test.
paul: I'll also add semver normalizer that maps shouty->preserve when the string payloads match ignoring case, so tiny cosmetic enum casing won't trigger minor.
devex-bot: created issue #1407 "enum casing regen causing spurious semver bump + onboarding flaky retry" and attached CI job 6120.
ivy: thanks team — once PRs land let's run a canary publish to staging and then unpin. leaving note in release runbook and tagging owners. :white_check_mark:
